verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report says Jev was used via OpenRouter with sub-400ms replies (jev-comm-4), which corroborates availability through an OpenRouter-class router. The SDK changelog mentions adding examples for use with AI gateways (jev-docs-27). First-party docs otherwise describe only TypeSafe's own `POST /v1/systemone` endpoint (jev-docs-30), and there is no evidence of availability on any major cloud. missing for 10: Bedrock availability, Vertex availability, Azure availability, first-party docs listing supported gateways or routers and confirming parity with the native endpoint.
